correctness.rationale: For every indexed cyclic output, the consecutive pair overlaps of a predecessor give a closed labeled walk, and conversely closure enforces precisely the wraparound identifications even at n=1,2. The deterministic Boolean-product state makes one accept/reject decision per output word, irrespective of the number of closed walks. The degree-40 full-state identity propagates under further powers of the transition operator, so Q times the count series has degree at most 39. The proposed series has the same bound (the polynomial correction has degree 5), so checking degrees 0–39 determines it exactly. The formal constant 1 matches acceptance at the identity. An independent ordered-pair set implementation verified the 735 reachable states, every component of the identity, all 40 initial coefficients, and literal images at n=1–16; for n=2 the image is exactly {00,11}.

originality.rationale: The asserted count and rational expression have exact equivalent coverage in the distinct published Resultary finding 4412da3b7a44. The observable, quantifiers including n=1,2, and six polynomials agree. The only series convention difference is the formal constant 1. The degree-40 vector certificate is a different and shorter proof check than that finding's 735 scalar recurrence checks, but is not a new count or formula. This is a finding about equivalent indexed coverage, not a determination that the other, later-dated entry had earlier publication or independent priority.
residual_risks: The dates and mirrored statements do not establish publication provenance or historical priority. Exact equivalent coverage is independent of that uncertainty.
